title: A constructible finite source is generically lisse
statement: Let $S$ be an integral Noetherian affine scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $g:Z\to S$ be finite, and let $E$ be an abelian etale sheaf whose underlying set sheaf is constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. There exists a dense open $U\subseteq S$ such that the underlying set sheaf of the abelian inverse image $E|_{g^{-1}(U)}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is finite locally constant [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].

source.place: ## Proof, first three paragraphs (closedness, reduction, generic lisse source)

proof.text: The finite map is integral, hence affine and universally closed. Its source is Noetherian, since it is of finite type over a Noetherian scheme. Replace the source by its reduction via universal-homeomorphism invariance of the etale site. There are finitely many irreducible components.

Remove the closed images of components not dominating S. Points of the generic fibre are generic points of the remaining components: after tensoring the finite algebra with the fraction field, its primes are minimal because it is Artinian. For each such point, the irreducible lisse stratification supplies a locally closed stratum containing it, hence an open neighbourhood within that component. Shrink to avoid the other components. The resulting neighbourhoods are open in the source and disjoint, and their union W is lisse and contains the generic fibre.

The image of the closed complement of W is closed and misses the generic point of S. Its complement U is open and dense, and g^{-1}(U) is contained in W. Restriction preserves finite local constancy. If there is no dominating component, this inverse image is empty and the stalk condition is vacuous. Transport back through the reduction equivalence.

Use the comparison between the set inverse image of the underlying sheaf and the underlying sheaf of the abelian inverse image to express source lissity by the displayed abelian restriction. Transport trivializations and finite stalks through that isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dense_open_lisse_finite_source
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral S] [IsNoetherian S] [IsAffine S]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ S) [IsFinite g]
    (E : Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hE : IsConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose Z.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj E)) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, Dense (U : Set S) ∧
      IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets
        ((sheafCompose (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.smallEtaleTopology
          (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj E))
